title: Computational Radiomics System to Decode the Radiographic Phenotype

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Computational Radiomics System to Decode the Radiographic Phenotype》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Radiomics aims to quantify phenotypic characteristics on medical imaging through the use of automated algorithms.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Source code, documentation, and examples are publicly available at www.radiomics.io With this platform, we aim to establish a reference standard for radiomic analyses, provide a tested and maintained resource, and to grow the community of radiomic developers addressing critical needs in cancer research.

evidence.text: Radiomics aims to quantify phenotypic characteristics on medical imaging through the use of automated algorithms.

Source code, documentation, and examples are publicly available at www.radiomics.io With this platform, we aim to establish a reference standard for radiomic analyses, provide a tested and maintained resource, and to grow the community of radiomic developers addressing critical needs in cancer research.
